test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered $1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. There was a woman on the station platform. A tall scrag of a woman wearing a little round hat with a brown feather that dropped in a draggled fringe over her eyes.

A. The toss and tumble, the hurrying threading rush of movement left her high and dry.

B. Brown button boots showed under the skirt and an end of white petticoat dabbled with mud.

C. Round her neck some indescribable little dead animal bit its own tail, its fur standing up wet and sticky like the fur of a drowned kitten.

D. She was dressed in a brown jacket and a narrow brown skirt and in her bare hands she clutched a broken down-looking leather bag-the outside pockets bulging with what looked like old torn-up envelopes.

S2. She stood as though she were part of the furniture of the station and had been there for years-an old automatic machine that nobody dreamed of slipping a coin into or even troubled to glance at to find out what once it contained-whether a drop of white rose perfume or a cachet or deux cigarettes a la reine d'Egypte.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given paragraph revolves around a vivid description of a woman on a station platform. The sentences need to be arranged logically to maintain coherence and unity.
 
• **Sentence D is the first sentence** as it describes her general appearance and belongings: 
 
 
• "She was dressed in a brown jacket and a narrow brown skirt and in her bare hands she clutched a broken down-looking leather bag-the outside pockets bulging with what looked like old torn-up envelopes."
 
 
 
• **Sentence C follows** as it further elaborates on her accessories, highlighting the peculiar dead animal: 
 
 
• "Round her neck some indescribable little dead animal bit its own tail, its fur standing up wet and sticky like the fur of a drowned kitten."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B comes next** as it describes her lower clothing and footwear, which complements the details in D and C: 
 
 
• "Brown button boots showed under the skirt and an end of white petticoat dabbled with mud."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A is the last sentence** as it gives a broader context to her surroundings and her isolation: 
 
 
• "The toss and tumble, the hurrying threading rush of movement left her high and dry."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **DCBA**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"She was dressed in a brown jacket and a narrow brown skirt and in her bare hands she clutched a broken down-looking leather bag-the outside pockets bulging with what looked like old torn-up envelopes. Round her neck some indescribable little dead animal bit its own tail, its fur standing up wet and sticky like the fur of a drowned kitten. Brown button boots showed under the skirt and an end of white petticoat dabbled with mud. The toss and tumble, the hurrying threading rush of movement left her high and dry."</div
